selector.why: The presence of bilateral symmetric sclerotic changes, multifocal intramedullary sclerosis, and diffuse infiltration by foamy histiocytes with rare Touton-like giant cells, along with the specific immunohistochemical staining pattern, decided it.

support_spans: 4-year history of diffuse bone pain around the knees and elbows
blurred vision, bilateral exophthalmos, and difficulty walking
bilateral symmetric sclerotic changes of the distal femora and proximal tibiae

contradict_spans: no granulomas or malignant cells were identified
